name: Sakisaka Yosuga
source:
One day, he gained the peculiar "magic ability" to "feel other people's emotions with his sense of taste." To be more precise, the expression "being swayed around" is more accurate than "being able to taste", and the person himself feels pain about his "magic".

As a result, he dislikes crowds and often skips school. To put it simply, his personality is "normal", but he is in the prime of puberty, having frequent fights in junior high school, being a bad boy, being highly sensitive, and having an extremely timid side.

He knows the meaning of his name because his mother told him. He doesn't hate it, but still feels like it's a burden.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210303215447/http://norplus.boo.jp/ysg/top.html]official website[/url]]
